description: This line plot illustrates the Accuracy@1 (%) of two models, GPT-4o and a partially obscured model starting with "Claude-3", across varying numbers of child nodes. The x-axis is labeled "...um. of Child Nodes (Tree Width)" and features a linear scale with visible numeric ticks at 3 and 5, suggesting an interval of 2, though data points are plotted at four distinct, evenly spaced positions along the axis. The y-axis is labeled "Accuracy@1 (%)" and utilizes a linear scale with a visible range from 15 to 35, marked at intervals of 5. The line representing GPT-4o is a solid blue line with circular markers; it begins at an initial value of 24.4, increases to 28.9 at the x-axis tick of 3, reaches a peak of 34.4 at the x-axis tick of 5, and then declines to a final value of 31.1. The line representing the "Claude-3" model is a solid light blue line with 'x' markers; it starts at 26.7, rises slightly to a peak of 27.8 at the x-axis tick of 3, decreases to 24.4 at the x-axis tick of 5, and continues to decline to end at 20.0.
